// Test-only adapter; the implementation above is unchanged.
func PortScalarOutline(token *cst.Token, atRoot bool) string {
    hex := func(units []uint16) string { var b strings.Builder; for _,u:=range units { fmt.Fprintf(&b,"%04x",u) }; return b.String() }
    var errors []string
    onError := func(source any,code,message string,warning bool) {
        pos:=getErrorPos(source)
        errors=append(errors,fmt.Sprintf("%d,%d,%s,%s",pos[0],pos[1],code,hex([]uint16(stringToUnits(message)))))
    }
    var result scalarResolution
    if token.Type=="block-scalar" {
        result=resolveBlockScalar(&composeContext{atRoot:atRoot,options:&Options{Strict:true}},token,onError)
    } else { result=resolveFlowScalar(token,true,onError) }
    ranges:=[]string{};for _,v:=range result.valueRange { ranges=append(ranges,strconv.Itoa(v)) }
    root:=0;if atRoot { root=1 }
    return fmt.Sprintf("%s|%d|%d|%s|%s|%s|%s|%s",token.Type,token.Offset,root,hex(result.value),result.scalarType,strings.Join(ranges,","),hex(stringToUnits(result.comment)),strings.Join(errors,";"))
}
